name: returns
title: Returns
description: How investments performed over a window (default: since the first snapshot), as twr and mwr %, after fees and taxes. view=global: the whole portfolio. sources, portfolios: per entity, best-effort. accounts: per account, exact. stated: a document's stated periods beside the engine's figures; it takes no method, period, annualize, netting, inception, benchmark or currency. bridge: why net worth moved, for the whole household: end_net_worth = start_net_worth + net_saved + onboarded + gain; whole months; it takes no method, annualize, netting, inception, benchmark, source or account. One row per entity for the whole window unless period adds buckets. quality names the reason for every n/a. Example: {view: "accounts", from: "2025", to: "2025"}.

account.description: Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).

annualize.description: auto (default; only spans of a year or more), always, never.

benchmark.description: view=global only: the benchmark beside each row, over the days both sides have. One of Global 60/40, Global 80/20, S&P 500, US total bond market, World (ACWI), or a name from the config's benchmarks block.

currency.description: Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

from.description: Window start; snaps to the unit's start.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

netting.description: Net internal transfers at coarse grains (default true).

period.description: Bucket size (default total: one row per entity for the whole window).

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

source.description: Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.

to.description: Window end; snaps to the unit's end. Default today unless the tool says otherwise.

view.description: Grain (default global); stated and bridge are side views.
